personal.name: Hitarth Patel

Proven track record across the full SDLC, improving system reliability by 30%, cutting production error rates, and boosting database performance. Strong product engineering mindset with a focus on System Design, Microservices, and DevOps best practices to drive measurable outcomes and technical excellence.

points: Architected and maintained scalable backend services, databases, and RESTful APIs supporting multiple production websites, improving overall system reliability by 30%.

Collaborated with senior software engineers to implement product features using React, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and backend logic.

projects.title: QuickAlert
